implementation_and_verification_requirem: Durable atomic reservation of a stable public port per VM destination
TCP/UDP/both on the same reserved public port; protocol changes preserve allocation
Authenticated owner-aware expose/list/remove management; no observer or unrelated owner access
Gateway recovery after restart and guest reboot without remapping a reserved public port
Bounded peer/task/queue budgets and explicit listener configuration
Real native datagram checks through owned control/node/KVM services
Removal and guest deletion release the exact owned reservation and listener
Matched performance evidence without assuming local stream tunnel results apply to native ingress
